source: Approved E unsecured-debt scope and approved D zero unused overdraft capacity; model specification, not an empirical benchmark
rule: An unfunded senior payment/negative end-quarter deposit ages as an unsecured overdraft claim repayable on demand. After the same N, cancel only the negative-deposit claim, charge its deposit bank, preserve the formal loan book, and record household_overdraft_relief as a noncash accounting term.
uncertainty: Quarterly senior-payment distress proxy for unauthorized overdrafts; the household file has no observed credit limits or arrears. No Canadian legal repayment schedule is claimed; no value fitted to a gate.
foreclosure_reporting: Actual mortgage losses now populate the mortgage NPL reporting path, rather than being returned as zero.
